links.outcome: Errors and anomalies in ChatGPT-generated essays on curriculum learning objectives
links.effect: A high error rate was observed when generating essays; hallucinations caused texts to deviate from current scientific knowledge.
links.quote: however, when it came to generating essays a high error rate was observed.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT (GPT-3.5) on German medical board exam questions and essay generation tasks for anesthesiology/emergency medicine education without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
